Title: Administrator
Subject: Who keys your physicians' orders into {{RIS_Name}}?
Body: Hi {{firstName}}, How many of the orders from 17 physicians and 10 nurse practitioners across pulmonary, critical care and sleep still arrive by fax and get typed into {{RIS_Name}}? Gravity can work those orders on its own, from the fax to the schedule, on top of {{RIS_Name}}. Your team reviews the exceptions instead of re-keying the rest. You can see the order's path, step by step. Worth 15 minutes next Tuesday or Thursday? Best,

If taking the fax backlog off your team's plate isn't a priority right now, no worries at all. If it is, let me know if next Tuesday or Thursday works for a quick chat, or look at the journey first and tell me what you think. Best,
